name: MXFP8 (OCP microscaling FP8, E4M3 + E8M0)
activation_scheme: shared E8M0 power-of-two scale per 32-value block; element format E4M3 (or E5M2). Same microscaling family as MXFP4, and the scale recipe Blackwell's blockwise FP8 GEMM actually uses.
kernels: TensorRT-LLM Blackwell blockwise FP8 GEMM (MXFP8 recipe)
notes: MXFP8 is the 8-bit member of the same OCP microscaling family as MXFP4 - which the enum treats as a separate value, correctly, because the element format (E4M3/E5M2 vs E2M1) and the supported hardware both change. It is directly evidenced as a shipping hardware recipe by the TensorRT-LLM documentation footnote that FP8 blockwise-scaling GEMM kernels on sm100/103/107 use the MXFP8 recipe (E4M3 act/weight with UE8M0 act/weight scale), slightly different from the SM90 FP8 recipe (E4M3 with FP32 act/weight scale) - quant-trtllm-quantization. So on Blackwell, 'blockwise FP8' effectively means MXFP8. The MX family supports any element E/M combination (E2M1, E3M2, E4M3, E5M2 are the common ones) under the shared-scale block scheme. No quality delta recorded.
